src/agent_runtime/managed_settings.py

Python · Tier A

Persist revisioned startup overrides independently of running settings and editable workspace paths. Merge patches over a validated bootstrap model, resolve secret environment references only for effective use and present configured markers publicly. Cross-process file locking serializes revision checks, lifecycle hooks and atomic replacement; callers restart services and own any separate relocation recovery.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
ManagedSettings 23 Own one managed file, validation model, bootstrap/active pair and explicit editable/secret field sets. File changes affect saved/effective views while active settings remain the supplied process snapshot.
ManagedSettings.effective 106 Load and validate saved overrides against bootstrap values without mutating the active process or saving a new revision.
ManagedSettings.view 123 Project saved references, validated effective settings, active settings and bootstrap defaults with secret values masked. Restrict the editable JSON schema and represent secret fields as environment-reference objects; report source, revision and whether saved values differ from active values.
ManagedSettings.change 169 Validate patch/revision inputs, lock the private configuration directory and reload current state before optimistic revision comparison. Reset selected overrides then deep-merge the patch, validate the candidate and lifecycle transition. Preview returns a prospective next revision without saving; save bounds the complete document, runs staging, atomically replaces and syncs the parent on POSIX. Errors after staging/replacement do not imply rollback of those separate effects.
